# Portkeep

> Portkeep is a free, open-source (MIT) macOS menu bar app that keeps port forwards up. It runs SSH (-L, -R, -D, ProxyJump), AWS Session Manager, kubectl port-forward, Google Cloud IAP, Cloudflare Access and custom commands, reconnects them after sleep, a network change or a dropped session, and says in plain language which tunnel failed, why, and that it is already reconnecting.

Key facts:

- Platform: macOS 14 Sonoma or later, Apple silicon or Intel. Current version: 0.3.0.
- License: MIT. Price: free. Author: Rattamnoon Kiratipisut.
- Status is honest: a tunnel shows Connected only when its local port accepts connections.
- Reconnect backs off from 1 s to 60 s and spends no retries while offline.
- Tunnels may share a local port (for example production and development MySQL on 3306); switching one on switches the other off first.
- On-demand tunnels hold the port and open the real tunnel when a client connects, then stop after 10 idle minutes.
- Portkeep never stores passwords, keys or tokens. It uses your existing ~/.ssh/config, AWS profiles and kubeconfig, so authentication must already work without typing.
- Command line: `portkeep list | status | start | stop | toggle | start-group | stop-group | start-all | stop-all | open`, and the same actions as `portkeep://` URLs.
- Interface languages: English, Thai, Simplified Chinese, Japanese.
- Not on the Mac App Store (the sandbox would stop it running your CLIs). Releases are not notarized yet.

Install:

```
brew install --cask rattamnoon/tap/portkeep
```

Or download the .dmg from https://github.com/rattamnoon/portkeep/releases/latest.

## Docs

- [Get started](https://rattamnoon.github.io/portkeep/docs/): install (Homebrew, .dmg, source), first launch and Gatekeeper, add a first tunnel in five steps
- [The menu](https://rattamnoon.github.io/portkeep/docs/menu.html): master switch, group tabs and switches, tunnel rows and states, the ⋯ actions, the menu bar icon's attention dot
- [Adding tunnels](https://rattamnoon.github.io/portkeep/docs/tunnels.html): every editor field, Advanced Options, the Runs preview, Test Connection, editing and removing
- [Connection methods](https://rattamnoon.github.io/portkeep/docs/methods.html): SSH -L/-R/-D and ProxyJump, AWS SSM, kubectl, Google Cloud IAP, Cloudflare Access, custom commands; the command each runs and worked examples
- [Status and troubleshooting](https://rattamnoon.github.io/portkeep/docs/status.html): every status and failure message with its fix, reconnect backoff, sleep and wake, logs, notifications
- [Local ports and on demand](https://rattamnoon.github.io/portkeep/docs/ports.html): port conflict checks, shared ports for switching environments, start when an app connects
- [Settings](https://rattamnoon.github.io/portkeep/docs/settings.html): sidebar and search, tunnel page, Groups & Tags, Tools paths, General (language, notifications, login item)
- [Command line and URLs](https://rattamnoon.github.io/portkeep/docs/automation.html): portkeep commands, exit codes, status.json, portkeep:// URLs, Raycast and Shortcuts examples
- [Import and export](https://rattamnoon.github.io/portkeep/docs/import-export.html): Export/Import Tunnels JSON, Import from SSH Config (Include, LocalForward, DynamicForward)
- [Files, backup and privacy](https://rattamnoon.github.io/portkeep/docs/data.html): tunnels.json and the other files, backup, uninstall, what Portkeep stores and sends
- [FAQ and limits](https://rattamnoon.github.io/portkeep/docs/faq.html): common questions and the limits of this version
- [README](https://github.com/rattamnoon/portkeep/blob/main/README.md): features, connection methods, install, usage, command line and URLs, file locations, limits
- [FAQ](https://rattamnoon.github.io/portkeep/#faq): keeping an SSH tunnel alive on macOS, autossh, AWS SSM to RDS, kubectl port-forward reconnects, credentials, switching environments on one port, install, price
- [Contributing](https://github.com/rattamnoon/portkeep/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md): build, test and pull request guidelines
